context: A boss reviews quarterly pricing strategy with his deputy
purpose: Teach: 引き下げ/免除/落札/需給/補完/著名/完結/出入り

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今期の価格戦略だが、主力商品の引き下げをどこまで踏み込むか、君の意見を聞きたい。
lines.en: Regarding this quarter's pricing strategy, I want your view on how far to push the price reduction on our flagship products.
lines.style: Authoritative boss, measured tone, opens with directive framing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 需給バランスを見ますと、競合が著名な大手二社に絞られてきていますので、価格よりブランド面で勝負すべきかと。
lines.en: Looking at supply and demand, competition has narrowed to two well-known major players, so I think we should compete on brand rather than price.
lines.style: Deputy speaking carefully, analytical, deferential but confident.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: なるほど。ただ先月の入札で例の案件を他社に落札されただろう。あれは価格負けだ。
lines.en: I see. But last month we lost that bid to a competitor, didn't we. That was a defeat on price.
lines.style: Pushes back gently, references concrete setback to test deputy.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: おっしゃる通りです。ですので低価格帯は補完ラインとして残し、関税免除の対象品目に絞って原価を下げる案を検討しております。
lines.en: You're absolutely right. So I'm considering keeping the low-price range as a complementary line and cutting costs by focusing on items eligible for tariff exemption.
lines.style: Concedes point, pivots to detailed counter-proposal with specifics.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 悪くない。倉庫の出入りも最近激しいから、在庫回転と合わせて数字を出してくれ。
lines.en: Not bad. Warehouse traffic has been heavy lately too, so give me the numbers together with inventory turnover.
lines.style: Approving but demanding, layers additional operational requirement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。本件は今四半期で完結させ、来期は新規市場の議論に移れるよう資料をまとめます。
lines.en: Understood. I'll wrap this matter up within this quarter and prepare materials so we can move to discussions of new markets next term.
lines.style: Crisp acknowledgment, signals follow-through and forward planning.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 頼んだ。金曜の役員会までに頼む。資料は簡潔にな。
lines.en: I'm counting on you. Have it ready by Friday's board meeting. Keep the materials concise.
lines.style: Closes briskly, delegates with clear deadline and constraint.
